summary: Retested the iteration-6 fixes. BACKEND: 9/9 new tests pass (test_iteration7_photo_cache_dedupe.py). PUT /api/me/onboarding de-duplicates stores: ['Aldi','Aldi'] saves ['Aldi'], order is kept for ['Tom Thumb','Aldi','Tom Thumb','H-E-B','Aldi'], all 7 stores still save, ['Kroger']x8 returns 422 and an unknown store returns 400. Photos: a fresh demo user gets all 6 items checked, 5/6 with photos (all 5 food items; Tide Pods has no OFF match, which is expected). A second demo user reuses db.photo_cache, finishes in under 20 s, and gets identical URLs. Fresh-lookup path verified by deleting the Cheerios and Milk cache entries: Whole Milk got an OFF 503 on attempt 1, was left unchecked, retried and got its photo; both cache entries were rebuilt with URLs, all checked in 12.7 s. Retry cap verified on TEST_Nutella (search busy on 4 attempts, then given up as checked/no photo without caching). PUT resets image_url/image_checked. Regression: 120/120 pass (excluding flaky check_live). FRONTEND (390x844, demo): Watchlist shows 6 cards with 5 real product thumbnails and a bag icon for Tide. Names are no longer cut off ('Laundry Detergent Pacs' and 'Boneless Chicken Breast' wrap to 2 lines; scrollWidth equals offsetWidth). The 'On sale' pill is now on the brand/size row. After scrolling to the bottom, the last card's trash (y=615-655) no longer overlaps the FAB (y=704). Trash removes the item without navigating, the banner reads 'Removed … Changed your mind? Undo', and Undo restores it (6 cards, plus a '… is back on your list' banner). Store picker: 3/7 to 7/7 by tapping Aldi, H-E-B, Tom Thumb and Sprouts; Save returns to Profile showing all 7 chips. No deprecated Expo packages.

minor.issue: Non-HTTP failures (e.g. httpx.ReadTimeout/ConnectError; the log shows 'Image lookup failed for TEST_Nutella Hazelnut Spread: ' with an empty message, which is typical of a timeout) still go to the generic except branch and save a permanent 'no photo' for that item. They should be treated like PhotoServiceBusy (retry with attempts). They are not cached, so other users are unaffected.

Negative results (url=None) are cached forever with no TTL, so a product OFF couldn't match is never retried for any user. Consider expiring negative entries (e.g. 7 days) using the existing 'at' field.

issues: Before scrolling, the FAB (60x60 at y=704) still covers the trash icon of the last visible card (Large Eggs) at 390x844. It's fine after scrolling thanks to the 120 px bottom padding. Minor and unchanged.

With the 'On sale' pill on the meta row, longer brand/size text is now cut off ('Folgers Classic R…', "Eggland's Best · 12 …"). This is an acceptable trade-off, but the meta could wrap or the pill could go on its own line.

action_items: Optional: in fill_images, treat httpx.TimeoutException / httpx.TransportError as PhotoServiceBusy (retry) instead of saving a permanent 'no photo'.
Optional: add a TTL to negative photo_cache entries (url=None).
Optional: keep the FAB from covering the last visible card's trash icon before scrolling, and consider letting the brand/size meta wrap when the 'On sale' pill is shown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:271: dedupe runs after Pydantic max_length, so 8 entries with duplicates return 422. That's acceptable because the UI can't send duplicates.

server.py:409-412: in the busy path, `continue` plus sleep(5*attempts) runs inside the same job, so with many busy items one job can take a while. This is OK because there is one job per user (_image_jobs) and the frontend polls to re-trigger it.
The photo_cache key mixes barcode and 'brand name' strings in one namespace. Collisions are unlikely, so this is fine.
seed_data_creation: Fresh demo users only. The TEST_Nutella item was created and deleted. I temporarily deleted the Cheerios/Milk photo_cache entries (rebuilt with URLs) and removed the 'nutella test_nutella hazelnut spread' cache entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: photo_cache is warm for the 6 demo items (5 URLs, Tide=None). To exercise the live OFF path, delete cache entries first (keys are lowercase 'brand name'). OFF search.pl still returns 503 frequently; check backend.err.log for 'Photo service busy'. Run check_live with -n 0.
